# `aitbc blockchain stop`

Stop a secondary chain on the local node.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc blockchain stop [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | yes | The Chain id. |
| `--node-url` | text | `http://127.0.0.1:8202` | no | Local node RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc blockchain stop --chain-id <chain_id>
```
